name: Ochanomizu
tagline: Otemachi in 4 minutes and Tokyo in 5 minutes. Served by 4 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥130,000 to ¥140,000.
summary: The station is in Chiyoda City, where JR East and Tokyo Metro run 4 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 4 minutes to Otemachi, 11 minutes to Shinjuku, 21 minutes to Shibuya and 19 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥130,000 to ¥140,000. The station stands 20.8 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 17.5 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 20.8 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 3.3 m to 20.8 m, a difference of 17.5 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 3 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is 3 to 5 m. For storm surge, 1 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 49 clinics and 46 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 名倉クリニック, about 3 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 日本大学歯学部付属歯科病院, about 4 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 4 lines serve the station. JR Chuo Rapid Line run through it. JR Chuo-Sobu Line (Local) also call here. Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line are available too. Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line stop here as well. The lines are split between operators (JR East runs 2 lines and Tokyo Metro runs 2 lines), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company.
congestion: JR Chuo Rapid Line runs at 158% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 中野→新宿, which this station is not on. Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line runs at 154%. Its busiest stretch is 新大塚→茗荷谷, which this station is likewise not on. JR Chuo-Sobu Line (Local) runs at 151%. Its busiest stretch is 錦糸町→両国, which this station is likewise not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥130,000 to ¥140,000 and 1K ¥140,000 to ¥150,000. 1LDK ¥220,000 to ¥230,000 and 2LDK ¥290,000 to ¥300,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

neighbours.lead: rents are lower at Ochanomizu, and Ochanomizu is ahead on the number of lines and how close the centre is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to. It takes 6 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Ochanomizu. One-room rents run about ¥14,000 higher.

neighbours.lead: Suehirocho is ahead on how easy the shopping is, but Ochanomizu is ahead on the number of lines and how little of the area is in the flood projection.

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 14 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 1 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, comparatively few of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: 4 lines serve the station, and the choice of connections is wider than at most stations in the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the lowest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are heavily loaded in the morning.
